purpose: Evidence for the project owner's own decision on whether docs/NRE-1.0-MASTER-PROMPT.md's Milestone 2 acceptance criterion is satisfied: "Given a historical/new event, the system can return defensible comparable historical events and reaction distributions." This file is NOT a declaration -- exactly like every acceptance step in this project, evidence is assembled here and the decision stays the owner's, in their own words, if and when they choose to make it.
what_full_milestone_2_acceptance_would_m: Full Milestone 2 ("Reaction Fingerprints": company-level event histories, sector histories, event-type histories, reaction statistics, analogue retrieval) is broader than what's evidenced here. This evidence is about the retrieval capability specifically -- the analogue_query()/pool_report() machinery working against real, accepted, per-issuer-deep data -- which is the part of Milestone 2 that Milestone 2 step 2 was built to unblock. Company-level and sector-level fingerprint statistics remain thin (see the withheld issuer-level cells noted below) and are not claimed here.

the_three_pieces_of_evidence.kind: aggregate pool health across the whole dataset
the_three_pieces_of_evidence.what_it_shows: Every one of the 68 accepted events (23 Milestone 1 + 45 Milestone 2 step 2) queried as its own historical target, at its own real cutoff, for every label. session_20_close_return's found-analogues rate went from 1 of 23 (Milestone 1 alone) to 44 of 68 combined; positive_gap_filled/positive_gap_retained_half went from 0 of 23 to 33 of 68. This is breadth: how often the system can answer at all, across the whole accepted dataset, not a single cherry-picked case.

the_three_pieces_of_evidence.kind: one worked historical-target query, in full
the_three_pieces_of_evidence.what_it_shows: CXT's own Milestone 1 event, queried across every label. For session_20_close_return: 10 analogues found (all from Milestone 2 step 2; Milestone 1's other 22 events contributed none), distance 0.5, correctly flagged REPORTED_UNRELIABLE (n=10 is below the policy's own reliability floor of 20 -- not overclaimed). CXT's own two step-2 events were correctly excluded from CXT's own query (LABEL_ABSENT / CORPORATE_ACTION_IN_WINDOW, the same dividend suppression already on record), not silently dropped -- a real test of whether the exclusion machinery holds up on a case already known to be tricky.

the_three_pieces_of_evidence.kind: one worked new-target query, in full -- the other half of the criterion's own wording
the_three_pieces_of_evidence.what_it_shows: A hypothetical premarket release for PDF Solutions (a real, already-vetted issuer, CIK 0001120914), as of today -- not a historical event in the dataset, exercising nre.fingerprints.new_target()'s own first-class support for exactly this. Deliberately a harder case, not a softball: none of this issuer's own sector's real events are premarket. Retrieval honestly reached the policy's own max_distance (1.0) to gather 35 members, plainly reporting distance_reached: 1.0 rather than hiding the stretch or refusing to answer -- the reader can judge the pool's own relevance from that number, which is exactly what 'defensible' requires: not that every answer is strong, but that every answer states plainly how strong it is.

what_this_does_not_cover: No true out-of-sample validation: every analogue-pool member is drawn from the same accepted convenience sample described throughout this project (SCOPE_NOTE, unchanged), not an independent holdout.

Company-level and sector-level fingerprint statistics (as opposed to analogue retrieval) remain thin -- every issuer-level cell in reports/m2-combined-fingerprint-table-2026-09-29.json still reports all_statistics_withheld, since the policy's own report_from_n (5) exceeds even the deepest single issuer's event count (LOVE, 4).

Only two targets were worked through in full (one historical, one new); the aggregate pool report covers breadth across all 68 targets but only at the summary level (found/not-found, member counts), not full per-target comparable lists.
Nothing here predicts, scores, or ranks -- unchanged from every prior statement in this project. A defensible comparable-event answer is not a forecast.
not_a_claim: Not a declaration of full Milestone 2 acceptance -- that remains the owner's own decision, the same as every prior milestone step in this project.
Not evidence that any specific query would be useful for a real decision -- both worked examples are illustrations of the machinery's behavior, not investment or business guidance.
Not Milestone 3, and not an expansion of Milestone 2 step 2's own already-declared, already-accepted scope.
